plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lift so later percentage work is grounded in a real baseline, and the main program starts in Week 2. With only one weekly session, the priority is crisp power work first, then simple strength work, then a small amount of trunk, pull, and neck support without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power and full-body strength with simple, repeatable lifts that support boxing without excessive fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power output sharp while adjusting volume to boxing load and recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper power and speed expression while keeping enough strength work to hold the force base.

exercises.name: 1a. Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and confidently. Step down each rep and keep every jump fast and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if boxes are limited. Reset between reps and focus on height with a controlled landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Broad Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have floor space and no box. Stick the landing and avoid reaching with the feet.

exercises.name: 1b. Rotational Medicine Ball Scoop Throw
exercises.notes: Throw each rep hard from the hips with a non-bouncing or low-bouncing ball. Reset between reps and keep the quality high.

substitutionOptions.name: Medicine Ball Shotput Throw
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if wall space is tighter. Drive from the rear hip and finish tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Half-Kneeling Rotational Medicine Ball Throw
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if standing rotation is not controlled yet. Keep the torso tall and rotate sharply.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 reps with clean form. This session establishes your baseline for future percentage work, so stop before technique breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if shoulder mobility makes the back squat awkward. Keep the same hard but clean 3-5 rep top set.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if barbell squatting is not yet safe or confident. Go heavy enough to challenge posture and depth.

exercises.name: 3. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady load and pause briefly at the top. Pull the elbows back without shrugging.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the chest-supported station is taken. Keep the torso still and finish each rep to the ribs.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need a simpler setup. Keep the torso braced and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Use a controlled lower and an aggressive press. Keep the shoulders packed and feet set.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you prefer a fixed bar path and have a spotter or safeties.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if dumbbells are limited. Elevate the hands if needed so every rep stays clean.

exercises.name: 5. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Only roll out as far as you can keep the ribs down and lower back quiet. Move slowly out and pull back under control.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the wheel is too aggressive. Keep the same trunk position.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if rollouts bother the shoulders. Keep the movement strict and controlled.

exercises.name: 6. Plate Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Use very light load and smooth tempo. Stop immediately if you feel sharp pain, dizziness, or headache.

substitutionOptions.name: Band Neck Flexion and Extension
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if plates are awkward. Keep the resistance light and controlled.
